scope: Final audit of six HV scoped questions and root scope review; no registry mutation, source rerun, raw/image access, or new test.

question_checks.finding: The exact 21-occurrence/15-folio scope is retained. GDT805 projections have zero semantic/renderer credit and the GDT388 packet is formally ineligible after prior access; the draft correctly calls this unsupported meaning plus invalidity, not sample insufficiency or universal material-model failure.

The draft binds only the one qofchey occurrence. It preserves S00/F00 with level 0, moist 1/1/1, PREP 0/0/0, and C0 fallback/default. It does not transfer family-level preparation support or a form gate from other OFCH/chor cards.

The draft correctly states that V9 never predeclared a complete fixed binary encoding. The 38-type observation disfavors only the assumed two-surface/two-answer encoding; context-dependent binary semantic values remain untested. Exact repeated terminals support structural identity, not status or COMMIT meaning.

Entry bias, nine right neighbors, and the subjective .24 WATER rating are not treated as a refutation of the broader liquid/matrix rival. The draft also correctly says ownership of one wet object would not validate all five worksheet roles.

The draft distinguishes hardcoded attachment fallback and 27 equal-distance ties from semantic ambiguity or image-supplied action evidence. It retains the DCHOL learned-card claim as separate and unconfirmed.

The 14 reflows and 121 statements are treated as authored keyed interpretations, while existing nonline-bound surface structure is preserved. The draft does not turn byte-preserved mnemonics or consistency validation into semantic gold.

evidence_validation.method: All six decision evidence arrays were checked with tools.semantic_identity._evidence against contiguous paths, line spans, quotes and hashes.

reopening_scope: Reopening requirements remain conditional and claim-specific: a semantic promotion needs a specified rival and independently judged discriminating outcome. This does not require semantic gold before every future structural exploration; structural work may proceed when its own structural decision and falsifier are independently defined.
